description:
Signed preflight verdict on a counterparty BEFORE you pay them. Returns a three-state verdict (go | caution | avoid | unknown) with dated, signed evidence. Fewer than 3 independent observations in 30 days returns `unknown` with the coverage gap named — never a guessed `go`.

VALUE: The agent's first call: a signed three-state verdict on a counterparty before you pay them, with the coverage gap named when there isn't enough evidence.

PRICE: $0.01 USDC per call.

HOW TO PAY: USDC on eip155:8453, exact scheme, to 0xc8fF67FAE72596478599EAAcfad8656fAe1113c8. Sign an EIP-3009 transferWithAuthorization for the exact amount and put it in the `X-PAYMENT` header, then retry the same call. An unpaid call returns a `payment_required` payload with the amount, asset, network and payTo already filled in. The `synthex-x402` SDK (PyPI and npm) does the 402 -> sign -> retry loop in one call.
name: preflight
title: Preflight
